sam.w: quick hit 80% repro	9 onboarding marlin9b int4 - seeing a repeating "zipper" in embed cosine/PCA across positions. repro: `python tools/bench.py --model marlin9b --quant=int4 --seq=512 --batch=1 --dump-embeds`

sam.w: numbers: f16 top1 0.79, int8 0.78, int4 0.61; mean cosine f16 vs int4 = 0.64. pattern repeats every 128 tokens, alternating phase groups.

anya: export flags? rotary headwise/shared? proj packing? tokenizer version?

sam.w: rdw-quant-v2, `--quant-mode int4 --proj-order packed-qkv`, rotary default (shared), tokenizer bpe-nfkc-2025. no ln-fold.

ciro: packed-qkv + shared rotary is the usual suspect. quant noise can leak across heads when q/k packed; try `rotary.headwise=true` and unpack qkv. also try small `freq_scale` shifts.

maya: also rule out tokenizer id drift (quick `tokenizer.encode("Hi")` check) and KV warmup effects (`--kv-warmup 0` vs 64).

sam.w: did tokenizer check - ids match. starting small grid: headwise/shared x {freq_scale 0.98,1.0,1.02} x {packed,serial} x {ln-fold on/off}. first run (headwise+serial+1.0): int4 top1 -> 0.71, mean cosine -> 0.79; zipper reduced but visible >1024.

eva: sounds like cross-head leakage helped. next: dump per-head rotary cos/sin float vs quant and bisect which head(s) show biggest phase delta. if needed we can do per-head clipping or bias the quant bins.

sam.w: will dump per-head rotaries and embed PCA plots and post links. thanks, will report back. :thumbsup:
